sector_note: config.SECTOR_MAP is a present-day map, NOT point-in-time; sector EW from corrected_universe names excluding the ticker; Others / <6 names -> M150
earnings_note: results day = board-meeting event_date (ann_ts timestamps the intimation, not the release) [assumed]

a_mkt_adj.label: a) leg return - beta x M150 leg return

b_sec_adj.label: b) leg return - beta_sec x sector leg return

c_mkt_share.label: c) 1 - idiosyncratic variance share over the leg

d_deliv_ratio.label: d) delivery % on stop day / 60d median

e_results_5s.label: e) results board meeting within 5 sessions up to the stop

kill_rule: candidates for the January exploration lane: c_mkt_share, e_results_5s

hindsight_bound.rule: keep the stop only when |a| <= 1 SD (pooled); otherwise hold; R = post_ret21 x exit_px / risk
hindsight_bound.caveat: hindsight twice over (labels and post_ret21 look past the stop); upper bound for this rule, not a backtest
